exposure: induction of labour (IOL) method (amniotomy, prostaglandins, balloon catheter)
cohort: The study included 921 twin pregnancies at Lillebaelt University Hospital, Kolding, Denmark, between 2007 and 2019.
finding: The overall frequency of caesarean section was 35%, with emergency caesarean section rates of 28% for amniotomy, 41% for prostaglandin, and 53% for balloon methods when IOL was performed.
mod_finding: The rates of emergency caesarean section differed significantly depending on the induction of labour method, with prostaglandin and balloon catheter methods having higher rates than amniotomy.
